dashboard.label: SOC Co-Pilot — Triage Console
dashboard.description: Findings produced by the SOC Co-Pilot agent. Use thumbs up / down to give feedback — the agent folds it into its few-shot memory on the next run.

search.query: `soc_feedback` earliest=-7d | eval label=if(rating>0,"thumbs_up","thumbs_down") | stats count by label
`soc_findings` earliest=-24h | table _time, severity, rule_name, hypothesis, recommended_actions, notable_id | sort -_time

html.p: Run one of these searches to rate the most recent finding. The feedback_input modular input picks it up within 5 minutes and updates the agent's few-shot memory.
html.pre: | makeresults | eval notable_signature="Brute Force Access Behavior Detected::user", hypothesis="Successful brute-force from external IP", rationale="142 failures then a 4624 success from the same src", rating=1 | collect index=main sourcetype=soc_copilot:feedback
